name: 先天性大脳白質形成不全症（TUBB4A型）

sources.title: Hypomyelination with atrophy of basal ganglia and cerebellum

summary.text: A rare disorder characterized by slowly progressive spasticity, extrapyramidal movement disorders (dystonia, choreoathetosis and rigidity), cerebellar ataxia, moderate to severe cognitive deficit, and anarthria/dysarthria. Patients present with distinctive MRI findings of diffuse hypomyelination of the cerebral hemispheres, mild to severe cerebellar atrophy, and atrophy of the basal nuclei.
